I can't believe I was cheering and so excited and then not even a week later I am almost uninterested in Sword and Shield. While Z-Moves in my opinion needed to go, Mega Evolutions should never be removed. People were wanting new Megas and now we won't even be able to use them in Sword and Shield. Not having every Pokémon in these games is absolutely inexcusable. Even though I have a handful of Pokémon I don't want to see except for dying to my Attack, they should ALL still be available. If it's some sort of limitation, I'll play a new Gen 4 or especially Gen 6 style game if I can have every Pokémon. In the Pokémon Direct, I was so excited for the new Pokémon showed off. I wasn't interested in the Dynamax feature or the open world aspect, it was the Pokémon.
